Every winter, when temperatures drop, so does my body temperature. I just never seem to stay warm throughout the day, especially in my New York apartment, where my radiator never runs on a schedule. Either my apartment reaches the perfect temperature for only a few hours, or it gets so hot I end up opening my windows and losing all the heat.

There’s never a single day when I’m comfortably warm from morning to night. But when I learned about Renpho’s Heating Pad, I was instantly intrigued by the wearable pad that covers you from neck to waist and warms you to the core.
What is the Renpho Heating Pad?

The Renpho Heating Pad is a larger-than-normal heating pad (24″ wide x 33″ long, to be exact). Thanks to its size, it can cover your back, shoulders, and neck at the same time for warmth or pain relief (or both!). You can also wear it on your arms, legs, or stomach if that’s where you need a little extra toastiness. With six heat settings from 100 to 150 degrees, three time settings of 30, 60, or 90 minutes, and 10 super-soft color options, the Renpho Heating Pad is unlike any other I’ve come across.

The pad comes with a seven-foot-long power cord so you can comfortably move around your home, plus there’s a plush strap for your waist and a snap at the weighted collar to guarantee the heating pad stays in place as you move. But don’t worry if you spill on it — once you remove the controller, it’s machine washable (you’ll just have to let it air dry).

This wearable heating pad has a 4.4-star overall rating from over 25,000 reviews(!). One reviewer said, “This thing is a little pricey. Despite that, I would buy it 10x over. I LOVE this thing and I don’t know how I went so long without it.”

Another shopper said, “Definitely worth the money, it’s the best heating pad I have ever owned. I have low back and shoulder pain. It has been a lifesaver.” Other reviewers note they would recommend this heating pad without hesitation because of Renpho’s effective heat technology and unique wearable design.
